name: Study Time-Lapse
description: Start and stop a Study Time-Lapse capture session and open the renderer from your desktop, with a live estimate of photos, time studied and finish time. Needs a one-time setup (see the widget).
author: AmineChr54

commands.description: Checks whether Study Time-Lapse Capture.exe is running
Starts the 'StudyTimeLapse Capture' scheduled task (which runs Capture.exe)
Starts the 'StudyTimeLapse Render' scheduled task (which runs Render.exe)

studyHours.label: Planned study time (hours)
studyHours.hint: Use the same value as in Capture. Progress and finish time are estimated from it.

capturePath.label: Folder with Capture.exe (for setup text)
capturePath.hint: Only used to write the one-time setup commands shown in the widget. Umbra never runs this path.
